paragraphs: Rav Tuvi bar Matna, [Rosh Hashanah 19a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.19a.5). Rabbah bar Mattanah, [Shabbat 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.21a.11).[^2]

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot 23a spells Rav Adda’s patronym Matna. Hyman’s list gives Mattanah here.

The consulted Berakhot 23a reads מתנא for Rav Adda’s patronymic. The linked Niddah and Rosh Hashanah print מתנה for Chiyya’s and Tuvi’s patronymics, where the supplied list has מתנא. The list collects similar names from distinct notices.
